text:
Jimmy Snuggerud's second full season has a familiar St. Louis hook: the line is back together. Yahoo Sports and The Hockey News made the case for reuniting him with Robert Thomas and Dylan Holloway, and Mike Fink of The Hockey News called them the Blues' line to watch, with 13 goals and 20 assists between them.

Snuggerud has nine of those goals in 17 games, and by our win model his goals rank 26th in the league in wins added. He gets to the right places: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 96th percentile among forwards in chances from the home plate in front of the net last season, and 29% of his setups came from behind the net, more than three times a typical forward. But nine goals on 4.6 expected, shooting 23% after 12% last season, won't last, and the line has scored 5.9 more goals than its chances with him on. Evolving-Hockey also flagged the cost last season: opponents got more with him out there. Enjoy the goals, but expect the pace to settle.
headline: Snuggerud's line is back, his shooting is hot
